# Test Store Policy (synthetic fixture)

## 1. Returns and Refunds

### 1.1 Return window
Most products can be returned within **30 days of delivery**.

### 1.5 Refund timeline and method
The refund is initiated after the returned item passes a quality check.

## 2. Shipping and Delivery

### 2.1 Delivery charges
Delivery is **free on orders of ₹499 or more**. Orders below ₹499 have a delivery charge of **₹49**.

### 2.3 Where we deliver
We deliver **only within India**.

## 3. Warranty

### 3.1 Which products carry a warranty
A product carries a brand warranty only if its catalogue entry lists a warranty period.

## 6. Non-returnable Items

### 6.2 In-ear audio products
Wired earphones and wireless earbuds cannot be returned once the hygiene seal is broken.

## 7. Prices and Offers

### 7.4 No price matching
We do not match prices from other websites or stores.
